Are you an aspiring makeup artist who has a passion for makeup and would love to start a business doing makeup on clients professionally?

Does this sound familiar?

You spend hours and hours watching Youtube and Tik Tok makeup tutorials so you can learn new techniques

You love doing your own makeup and you are good at it

You did your friend or cousin's makeup for an event, she loved it and you felt such an amazing feeling of joy because you helped someone else feel even more beautiful

You have a passion for makeup and beauty, and now you would like to charge for makeup and turn it into a career, but you are not confident enough 

You work at a job that does not bring you joy and you would love to own a business in makeup so you can work from home and make your own schedule

I dreamed of all these things when I was going to cosmetology school, and after spending 15k on school, I realized they will not teach me enough about makeup. Because I did not have anyone to guide me and mentor me when ai was starting out, I made a ton of mistakes before building a successful freelance makeup business in Las Vegas, and then a Makeup Academy shortly after that. 

This is the reason I help artists nationwide get confident when applying makeup on clients, charging for their services, and starting a successful business in makeup, with a system, so they do not have to make the same mistakes I did when I was starting out. 

So I invite you to my FREE training where I outline my exact 5-step System to building a successful freelance makeup business, and I PROMISE, I will not try to sell you anything after that. 

P. S. I just want to help and spread my knowledge, as I have been exactly where you are right now. 

Send me a DM and I will send it to you for FREE!
